summary: The ignore file itself can produce errors for syntax problems, nonexistent paths or tests, ignoring errors that don't occur, ignoring skipped files, and duplicates.
questions: What errors can the sanity ignore file itself cause?

answer_card.title: Ignore file errors
answer_card.answer_md:
- Syntax errors
- Nonexistent file path
- Nonexistent sanity test
- Ignoring an error that doesn't occur
- Ignoring a skipped file
- Duplicate entries
